title: Does Elon Musk represent a new form of capitalism?: podcast
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克代表了一种新的资本主义形式吗？：播客
summary: By Peter Thal Larsen LONDON, June 23 (Reuters Breakingviews) - Follow on Apple or Spotify. Listen on the Reuters app. Read the episode transcript. Listen to the podcast.
summary_zh: 作者：Peter Thal Larsen 伦敦，6 月 23 日（路透社 Breakingviews）- 在 Apple 或 Spotify 上关注。在路透社应用程序上收听。阅读剧集文字记录。收听播客。

title: Qualcomm Nears Deal for AI Chip Startup Modular
title_zh: 高通接近与 AI 芯片初创公司 Modular 达成交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Qualcomm Inc. is in advanced talks to acquire Modular Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——高通公司正在就收购 Modular 公司进行深入谈判。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures waver as Wall Street weighs US-Iran talks, AI trade
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货因华尔街权衡美伊谈判和人工智能交易而波动
summary: US stock futures were little changed after a weak session on Wall Street as pressure on Big Tech and ongoing US-Iran talks weighed on sentiment.
summary_zh: 由于大型科技公司面临的压力以及正在进行的美伊谈判打压了市场情绪，华尔街股市疲软后，美国股指期货几乎没有变化。

title: US stocks end mostly lower, dragged by megacap tech; focus on Iran
title_zh: 受大型科技股拖累，美国股市收盘大多走低；聚焦伊朗
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes closed mostly lower on Monday, with the exception of the Dow, which gained just under a third of a percent.
summary_zh: 故事：周一，华尔街主要股指收盘大多走低，但道指除外，该指数上涨了不到三分之一。

title: Memory's price surge threatens Apple's 'magic formula' — and the economy: WSJ reporter
title_zh: 内存价格飙升威胁苹果的“神奇配方”和经济：《华尔街日报》记者
summary: Wall Street Journal technology reporter Rolfe Winkler discusses his interview with Apple (AAPL) CEO Tim Cook, who said that rising memory costs have made iPhone price increases "unavoidable."
summary_zh: 《华尔街日报》科技记者罗尔夫·温克勒 (Rolfe Winkler) 讨论了他对苹果 (AAPL) 首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 的采访，库克表示，内存成本上涨使得 iPhone 价格上涨“不可避免”。

title: SpaceX initiates first bond sale while the stock sheds post-IPO gains
title_zh: SpaceX 启动首次债券发行，而该股则失去了 IPO 后的涨幅
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) stock has sunk by as much as 13% in Monday's session — continuing to shave off any post-IPO gains — as the Elon Musk company is already announcing its first bond issuance.
summary_zh: SpaceX (SPCX) 股价在周一交易中下跌了 13%，继续削减 IPO 后的涨幅，因为这家埃隆·马斯克公司已经宣布发行首次债券。

title: Abbvie acquiring Apogee for $10.9B, Coca-Cola vs. IRS in appeals court
title_zh: Abbvie 以 $10.9B 收购 Apogee，可口可乐在上诉法院诉 IRS
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma joins Josh Lipton in highlighting the day's biggest stories and stock moves, including AbbVie's (ABBV) $10.9 billion acquisition of Apogee Therapeutics (APGE) and Coca-Cola's (KO) latest legal showdown with the IRS in US appeals court.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级记者布鲁克·迪帕尔玛 (Brooke DiPalma) 与乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 一起重点介绍了当天的重大新闻和股票走势，包括艾伯维 (AbbVie) (ABBV) 以 109 亿美元收购 Apogee Therapeutics (APGE) ...

title: SpaceX's retail boom runs into its first price wall
title_zh: SpaceX 的零售热潮遇到了第一道价格墙
summary: SpaceX instantly became a retail capital magnet. Now the stock is giving early buyers their first gut check.
summary_zh: SpaceX 立即成为零售资本的磁石。现在，该股正在给早期买家进行第一次直觉检查。

title: Micron earnings, PCE data, gas prices: What to watch this week
title_zh: 美光财报、PCE 数据、天然气价格：本周值得关注的内容
summary: Micron earnings and PCE data headline a busy week for investors.
summary_zh: 美光财报和 PCE 数据是投资者忙碌的一周的头条新闻。
